purpose: Map vague motion descriptions to exact animation terms for specs, prompts, and reviews.

terms.definition: A menu, popover, or panel scales/translates from the control or point that triggered it.
terms.examplePrompt: popover grows out of the button

terms.definition: A group of elements animate with small sequential delays rather than all at once.
terms.examplePrompt: items come in one by one

terms.definition: One visible element appears to persist and transform between two states or routes.
A resisted overscroll or drag boundary effect that snaps back when released.
One shape, icon, or form transforms into another while preserving continuity.
One element fades out while another fades in.
terms.examplePrompt: one image softly changes into another

terms.definition: Content is revealed by animating a hard-edged clipping shape.
terms.examplePrompt: panel wipes open with a hard edge

terms.definition: Content is revealed through a mask that can have soft or gradient edges.
terms.examplePrompt: image fades open through a soft shape

terms.definition: Digits roll or count to a new value.
Motion can be redirected or stopped mid-flight when user input changes.
terms.examplePrompt: drag can change direction without snapping

rules: Offer close alternatives only when useful.
Do not use this as a motion implementation or approval skill.
